questions.question_text: Match the word: boarding school
questions.correct_answer: A school where students live and study
questions.explanation: Students at a boarding school live at the school during the school term.

questions.question_text: Match the word: classmate
questions.correct_answer: A student in the same class as you
questions.explanation: A classmate is someone who studies in the same class.

questions.question_text: Match the word: uniform
questions.correct_answer: Special clothes worn by students at school
questions.explanation: A uniform is a set of clothes worn by members of a school or organisation.

questions.question_text: Match the word: laboratory
questions.correct_answer: A room used for scientific experiments
questions.explanation: A laboratory is a place where students or scientists do experiments.

questions.question_text: Match the word: gym
questions.correct_answer: A place where people do physical exercise
questions.explanation: A gym is a room or building used for sports and exercise.

questions.question_text: Match the word: canteen
questions.correct_answer: A place in a school where students can buy or eat food
questions.explanation: A canteen is a place where people can have meals or buy food.

questions.question_text: Match the word: playground
questions.correct_answer: An outdoor area where children play
questions.explanation: A playground is an area designed for children to play.

questions.question_text: Match the word: library
questions.correct_answer: A place where people can read or borrow books
questions.explanation: A library is a place that contains books and other reading materials.

questions.question_text: Students at a ______ live at school during the school year.
questions.explanation: A boarding school provides accommodation for students.

questions.question_text: My ______ sits next to me in English class.
questions.explanation: A classmate is another student in your class.

questions.question_text: Students must wear their school ______ on Mondays.
questions.explanation: A uniform is the special clothing students wear at school.

questions.question_text: We do science experiments in the ______.
questions.explanation: A laboratory is a room for scientific experiments.

questions.question_text: We play basketball in the school ______.
questions.explanation: A gym is a place for sports and physical exercise.

questions.question_text: I often have lunch with my friends in the school ______.
questions.explanation: A canteen is a place where students can buy or eat food.

questions.question_text: The children are playing football in the ______.
questions.explanation: A playground is an outdoor area where children play.

questions.question_text: You can borrow interesting books from the school ______.
questions.explanation: A library is a place where people can read or borrow books.

questions.question_text: Where do students do science experiments?
questions.explanation: Students do science experiments in a laboratory.

questions.question_text: Where can students borrow books?
questions.explanation: A library is a place where people can read and borrow books.

questions.question_text: What do students usually wear to school?
questions.explanation: A school uniform is special clothing worn by students.

questions.question_text: Where can students buy lunch at school?
questions.explanation: A canteen is a place where students can buy or eat food.

questions.question_text: What is a classmate?
options: A student in the same class
A person who works in a library
questions.explanation: A classmate is someone who studies in the same class as you.

questions.question_text: What is a boarding school?
options: A school where students only study online
A school where students live and study
A place where people borrow books
questions.explanation: Students at a boarding school live at the school while studying.

questions.question_text: Where do students usually play basketball indoors?
questions.explanation: A gym is an indoor place for sports and exercise.

questions.question_text: Which place is usually outdoors?
questions.explanation: A playground is generally an outdoor area for children to play.

questions.question_text: Which word means 'large and having a lot of space'?
questions.explanation: Spacious means large and having plenty of room.

questions.question_text: Our school has many modern ______. (FACILITATE)
questions.explanation: Facility is a noun meaning a useful building, service or piece of equipment. The plural is facilities.

questions.question_text: The new school building is very ______. (SPACE)
questions.explanation: Spacious is an adjective meaning large and having plenty of space.

questions.question_text: The school has a ______ computer room. (MODERN)
questions.explanation: Modern is an adjective describing something new or up to date.

questions.question_text: The students are very ______ with their new school. (PLEASE)
questions.explanation: Pleased is an adjective meaning happy or satisfied.

questions.question_text: The school provides many useful learning ______. (FACILITY)
questions.explanation: Facilities is the plural noun referring to useful spaces, equipment or services.

questions.explanation: A library is the place where students read or borrow books.

questions.explanation: A laboratory is a suitable place for science experiments.

questions.question_text: Find and correct the vocabulary mistake: We have lunch and buy food in the library.
questions.explanation: A canteen is a place where students can buy or eat meals.

questions.correct_answer: only visit for one hour → live and study

questions.correct_answer: small and crowded → large and has plenty of space

questions.explanation: Students can read and borrow books from a library.

questions.explanation: A uniform is a set of special clothes worn by students at school.

questions.question_text: A school has a room with test tubes, microscopes and other science equipment. What is this room?
questions.explanation: A laboratory is a room used for scientific experiments.

questions.explanation: A boarding school provides accommodation for students.
